text:
laura: Heads-up 1 - NorthPoint is green to start a 45-day POC but legal flagged compliance artifacts as the final gating item. They want: a SOC 2 control-to-evidence table (not full report), ISO certificate excerpt + scope page, a signed penetration-test authorization letter, a short KMS custody statement for the POC, and a small network/VPC diagram. Need before their legal kickoff on Mon.

hikaru: Quick clarifying Q 1 - do they want any sample logs or just pointers to where artifacts live? We normally send sanitized samples + policy excerpts.

olivia: Customer replied: "Prefer pointers + policy excerpts. No raw logs unless DPA amendment." So we'll prepare: control mapping + access-control policy excerpt + sanitized example only if needed.

laura: Can someone draft the KMS custody blurb? Two standard options: Redwood-managed (keys not exportable) or BYOK for Private. We'll present both and recommend BYOK for prod.

olivia: I'll do SOC2 mapping and ISO scope excerpt. ETA: tomorrow morning. I'll mark what needs redaction.

security-bot: SEC-TICKET-7201 created. Attach vendor name and CIDR to schedule external tests. Legal sign required for pen-letter; typical turnaround 48 business hours.

hikaru: Pen-test letter draft snippet: ```
Redwood Inference authorizes [vendor name] to perform coordinated, non-destructive penetration testing against the following targets during [start] 1 [end]. Tests must be scheduled at least 72 hours in advance with Redwood SRE and must not exfiltrate or alter customer data. Critical findings must be reported immediately to Redwood Security.
```

infra: For Dedicated/VPC we can assign a /28 and produce a simplified diagram in ~36 hrs after they confirm dedication. Hosted staging uses ephemeral IPs so external scans require Dedicated.

billing-bot: NOTE: Dedicated reserved capacity normally requires a commit. Sales can request a commercial exception for a short trial (e.g., 60-day reduced commit) 1 approve with finance.

laura: Customer also asked pricing for a 90-day Dedicated POC and whether it's refundable. We can offer a prorated refund before day 30 as a commercial exception; I'll draft options and send to pricing ops.

olivia: Action items: Olivia - SOC2 mapping + ISO excerpt (tom AM); Hikaru - pen-letter draft & legal ping (today); Infra - CIDR/diagram once they confirm Dedicated (36 hrs); Laura - pricing ask to billing ops (EOD). I'll message customer with these timelines now and propose a Wed alignment call.

laura: Customer follow-up: "Vendor is 'RedTeamCo'; prefer external scan. Proposed window next Tue-Fri. Can you confirm we can provide a signed letter by Friday?"

h ikaru: Pushing to Legal now. If we get vendor + CIDR today we should be able to get a minimal signature by Friday.

security-bot: SEC-TICKET-7201 updated: vendor=RedTeamCo, desired-window=next Tue-Fri. Assigned to infra for CIDR scheduling.

laura: Thanks all 1 will update customer and book the Wed call.
